works.title: MPM
works.intro: Full rebranding for a tech startup aiming to disrupt.
works.text1: MPM project was a comprehensive rebranding and digital transformation for an established billboard company looking to stand out in a competitive advertising market.
works.text2:
We began with an in-depth industry analysis, identifying key differentiators to position MPM as a modern, high impact advertising partner. Working closely with their leadership team, we crafted a strong brand identity designed to command attention focusing on bold, memorable visual elements, a high contrast color palette, and clear messaging that reflects MPM’s scale and reach.

From logo design and brand guidelines to typography and marketing collateral, every element was built to communicate trust, visibility, and modern media strategy. The new website was engineered with an intuitive user interface, making it effortless for media buyers, local businesses, and corporate clients to explore inventory, view location maps, and request quotes instantly.

Following the Launch, MPM experienced a significant boost in brand visibility and client inquiries. The updated digital presence streamlined the sales process, reduced response times for quote requests, and drove higher user engagement. The project stands as a powerful example of how strategic branding and user-centered web design can elevate a physical advertising business in a digital-first world.

works.title: GTZ
works.intro: Full rebranding for a tech startup aiming to disrupt.
works.text1: GTZ project was a comprehensive rebranding and digital transformation for an established BuildDesign company looking to elevate its presence in a competitive market.
works.text2:
We began with an in-depth industry analysis, identifying key differentiators to position GTZ as a premier, innovative leader in modern architectural design and construction. Working closely with their leadership team, we crafted a sleek, sophisticated brand identity designed to convey trust and structural excellence—focusing on refined typography, a modern color palette, and clear messaging that reflects GTZ’s commitment to precision and craft.

From brand guidelines and visual assets to marketing collateral, every element was built to communicate expertise, quality, and architectural vision. The new website was engineered with an intuitive user interface, making it effortless for prospective clients, property developers, and commercial partners to explore featured project portfolios, learn about GTZ’s integrated build-design methodology, and request consultations.

Upon Deployment, GTZ experienced a significant boost in brand recognition and high-value project inquiries. The upgraded digital presence streamlined client onboarding, elevated portfolio showcases, and increased user engagement. The project stands as a powerful example of how strategic branding and user-centered web design can transform a physical build-design firm into a market-leading digital brand.

works.title: VINDEX GYM
works.intro: Full rebranding for a tech startup aiming to disrupt.
works.text1: The Vindex Gym project brought to life a brand new, highperformance fitness facility entering a competitive market.
works.text2:
We began with an in-depth market analysis, identifying key differentiators to establish Vindex Gym as a premier destination for athletic conditioning, health, and personal growth right from day one. Working closely with the founders, we built a distinctive, high-energy brand identity from scratch to inspire motivation—featuring bold visual aesthetics, a dynamic color palette, and clear messaging that reflects Vindex Gym’s commitment to fitness excellence.

From logo design and brand guidelines to typography and digital assets, every element was created to communicate strength, community, and energy. The website was designed with an intuitive user interface, making it effortless for prospective members to explore class schedules, book personal training sessions, and sign up for memberships online.

Following the launch, Vindex Gym experienced a significant surge in initial member sign-ups and online inquiries. The new digital presence successfully established their market presence from launch day, streamlined the membership onboarding process, and drove strong community engagement. The project stands as a powerful example of how strategic brand creation and user-centered web design can launch a new fitness business for immediate success.

works.title: LITTLE ROOMS
works.intro: Full rebranding for a tech startup aiming to disrupt.
works.text1: Little Rooms, an intimate and conversational podcast, we crafted a distinct visual and conceptual identity designed to stand out in a crowded audio landscape.
works.text2:
Working closely with the hosts, we developed a cozy yet modern brand identity centered around the concept of personal space, deep conversations, and human connection. We created a custom logo mark and cover art optimized for readability across all major podcast platforms—from Spotify to Apple Podcasts—ensuring high visual impact even at small display sizes.

Beyond the primary cover art, we established a flexible brand design system featuring tailored typography, a warm color palette, and reusable social media templates. This empowered the creators to maintain a consistent, professional aesthetic across episode artwork, promotional clips, and audience touchpoints.

Following the brand launch, Little Rooms established an immediate, recognizable presence across streaming platforms and social media. The memorable visual identity helped increase listener click-through rates, drive audience engagement, and give the show a polished, established presence right from its debut episode.

works.title: CROATIA ZMRZLINA
works.intro: Full rebranding for a tech startup aiming to disrupt.
works.text1: Croatia Zmrzlina, a vibrant artisanal ice cream shop, we developed a fresh visual identity and produced captivating videography designed to capture the joyful essence of summer and craftsmanship.
works.text2:
We began by establishing a playful yet refined brand identity built to stand out on sun-soaked streets and digital screens alike. From custom logo design and vibrant color palettes to packaging design for cups, cones, and storefront signage, every element was crafted to evoke nostalgic summer vibes, freshness, and high quality.

To bring the brand to life, our team produced a suite of promotional social media videos and short-form video content. Capturing close-up shots of rich textures, fresh ingredients, and the artisanal ice cream-making process, the videography highlighted the passion behind every scoop and created an irresistible visual hook for local customers and tourists.

Following the launch, Croatia Zmrzlina made an immediate splash both online and on the ground. The striking video content generated high social media engagement and viral local reach, driving foot traffic directly to the shop and establishing Croatia Zmrzlina as a go-to summer destination.

works.title: CHOCO CAFFEE
works.intro: Full rebranding for a tech startup aiming to disrupt.
works.text1: Choco Caffee, a warm and indulgent café specializing in specialty coffee and handcrafted desserts, we created a rich visual identity and produced cinematic video content designed to elevate the brand and tempt taste buds.
works.text2:
We began by building a cohesive, inviting brand identity from the ground up. Combining warm, rich color tones with elegant typography and bespoke packaging details—from takeaway coffee cups to dessert boxes—every touchpoint was crafted to convey comfort, premium quality, and culinary passion.

To complement the new look, our production team created a series of high-energy promotional videos and appetizing short-form video clips. By focusing on sensory details—slow-motion shots of rich espresso pours, molten chocolate textures, and delicate dessert assembly—the video campaign captured the cozy ambiance of the café and brought its signature menu items to life online.

Following the brand and campaign release, Choco Caffee experienced high social media engagement and a significant increase in daily foot traffic. The video content drove strong online sharing across Instagram and TikTok, positioning Choco Caffee as a must-visit destination for coffee and dessert lovers alike.

works.title: QUBE
works.intro: Full rebranding for a tech startup aiming to disrupt.
works.text1: Qube, a modern café concept merging specialty coffee with precision-crafted desserts, we developed a sleek, contemporary brand identity designed to reflect structural simplicity and refined taste.^
works.text2:
Taking inspiration from modern architecture and clean geometric forms, we created a distinctive brand design system centered around balance, clarity, and sophistication. The visual identity pairs minimalist typography with a refined color palette, creating a strong contrast that lets the vibrant colors of their handcrafted desserts and rich coffee take center stage.

From logo design and brand guidelines to menu layouts, takeaway packaging, and custom coffee cups, every physical and digital touchpoint was crafted to deliver a cohesive, premium brand experience that stands out in a crowded café culture.

Following the launch, Qube established a bold, recognizable presence that immediately captured the attention of local coffee enthusiasts and design lovers. The clean, aesthetic brand presentation generated strong organic social media sharing, driving brand awareness and positioning Qube as a go-to destination for artisanal coffee and desserts.

works.title: ROYAL CONCIERGE
works.intro: Full rebranding for a tech startup aiming to disrupt.
works.text1: Royal Concierge, an elite luxury concierge firm providing bespoke lifestyle management and VIP client services, we delivered an end-to-end transformation encompassing brand strategy, custom web design, and EDV digital infrastructure.
works.text2:
We began by establishing a sophisticated brand identity that exudes exclusivity, trust, and discretion. Incorporating refined typography, a deep regal color palette, and subtle luxury details, every brand element—from digital assets to client-facing stationery—was crafted to resonate with high-net-worth individuals and corporate partners.

To support their high-touch services, we designed and built an intuitive, high-performance website that balances elegance with security. The platform seamlessly showcases their VIP offerings while providing private, secure portals for client inquiry and service requests.

Following the launch, Royal Concierge established a commanding market presence and significantly improved operational productivity. The seamless digital infrastructure reduced request turnaround times, while the elevated brand and web presence boosted high-value client acquisitions and client retention rates.
